outcome: Child behavior at 2 years of age
cohort: The study included 118 infants (53% male) diagnosed with colic.
finding: The baseline gut microbiota composition, including specific taxa like Bifidobacterium, Clostridium, Lactobacillus, and Klebsiella, associates with colic severity and can predict further crying at 4 weeks with up to 65% accuracy.
mod_finding: Alpha diversity of the fecal microbiota was strongly influenced by birth mode.
